topic: Effects of Human Activities on Ecosystems
key_concepts: Ecosystems contain biotic and abiotic components
Abiotic factors include soil, water, air, and temperature
Changes in abiotic factors can disrupt ecosystem balance
Pollution introduces harmful substances into air, water, and land
Air pollution from factories and vehicles contributes to climate change
Water and land pollution result from dumping wastes, sewage, chemicals, and unsegregated g
Habitat destruction occurs when forests and mountains are converted for human development
Overpopulation exceeds Earth's carrying capacity and degrades natural resources
Ecological balance is the equilibrium among living organisms and their environment
Population changes in one species affect other populations, such as predators and prey
